label: Subject Common Name (CN)
type: the legacy X.509 Subject field that can carry the username for client-certificate authentication - `subject.cn` is the default source in the Web Console's client-certificate handling. Deprecated by the IETF (RFC 6125 section 6.4.4) but retained by Couchbase Server for compatibility.
evidence: The Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) has deprecated the Subject Common Name as described in [section 6.4.4 of RFC 6125].
The _Common Name_ provided as `Subject` for the certificate is specified as `clientuser`, which is the name of an existing user.
Note that the default option is **subject.cn**, which indicates that the _Subject Common Name_ within the certificate is used.
note: The point worth filing is the contradiction between the two statements, which no single page draws: the field is documented as deprecated AND as the DEFAULT choice in the Web Console. Both are true and the reader is left to reconcile them. Filed with the `retainedForLegacyCompatibility` predicate that already exists for exactly this shape.
